author: China Insights
description:
Four years after the crash of China Eastern Airlines Flight MU5735, new materials and analysis have brought renewed attention to one of the most closely watched aviation incidents in recent years.

In this episode, we reconstruct the final moments of the flight using publicly available data, technical findings, and reported investigative materials. From the aircraft’s sudden descent to the absence of a distress call, we examine what is known, what remains unclear, and what questions continue to be raised.

Rather than drawing premature conclusions, this video focuses on the sequence of events and the technical context — offering a clearer understanding of what may have happened during those final seconds.

#MU5735 #Aviation #PlaneCrash #Investigation #FlightData #China #Analysis #Safety
title: The Final 90 Seconds: What New Data Reveals About Flight MU5735 I China Insights
